title: Logical token locations across nonblocking array feeds
summary: All 128 padded feed schedules emit START_ARRAY at (1,1), VALUE_TRUE at (2,5), and END_ARRAY at (5,6), matching the unpadded reference.

verdictLabel: Frozen public claims, original build pending
notes: Both properties start at ordinary application startup on Temurin 21. The original module is built separately on each revision. The public driver records the full observations for the independent finite oracle.

The parent matched the logical-offset oracle on 32 of 128 feed schedules and the fix matched on all 128. Both preserved token kinds and EOF. Native factory startup reaches ThreadLocal and ReferenceQueue construction. A fresh unpooled recycler produced identical JVM traces on each side. Its native constructor reaches AtomicReferenceArray.
